CreepJoinerFormKindDef.label: time traveler
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.description: A drifter in strange, ageing gear. There is something unsettlingly familiar about them - old scars and augmentations that you swear you have seen before. They claim to come from far away. They are quiet, withdrawn, and ask to stay a while.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterLabel: A weathered drifter in strange, ageing gear approaches your colony.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterPrompt: The drifter walks with the unhurried gait of someone who already knows the way. {PAWN_pronoun} carries gear that looks both familiar and impossibly old - scuffed, hand-mended, decades past its prime. {PAWN_possessive} eyes settle on one of your colonists for a moment too long, as though recognising a face long mourned.\n\n{PAWN_pronoun} asks only for shelter, and to be allowed to stay a while. {PAWN_pronoun} will not say where {PAWN_pronoun} came from.
